history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-fox-form-small
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-19: after the pilot (runs 44365539348 and 44369243023, identical: 36 games, no deaths, 16/16 non-Druid games identical), the owner asked to start a run in the zoo. RULES 14: the smallest Druid tier first; medium only after its gate and the owner.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-19, before any result of this tier was read; the pilot's results were read (gate passed: no
config_error, one binary, every cell turn_cap, no stall or frozen-turn burst, 16/16 non-Druid games identical; the
two Druids alive in both arms, CL 7/7 against 7/5, max depth 3/2 against 2/2).
Gate:
- no config_error; one binary; each arm's switch in its borg.txt and in params-core.json of the death replays;
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified and key outliers listed;
- death bundles reproduced.
Report per arm: deaths and causes, final level, deepest level; paired rescued and newly killed against off; per
game the "# Fox Form: fleeing" casts, "# Fox Form: reverting for an item or a spell" and "# Fox Form: reverting to
fight" notes, failed casts, and blows struck as a fox ("You bite" / "You claw"); for each Druid death, whether the
Druid was a fox, fleeing or changing back to fight in its last 100 messages.
10 Druids show direction only; a survival claim needs the medium tier (40 Druids with small) or more.
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main dbe99509, does a fleeing Druid that takes Fox Form (escape_fox_form 1) survive more often without costing anything?
